title: Root wk-tool delegation gate (conduct vs execute)
desc: A ROOT session (any tier) may use hands-on wk tools only inside a delegation window; in exchange it gets unlimited skill+markdown+delegate+git. Forces conductor mode, kills solo-flounder block-retry cache_read churn. Subagents exempt (executors).
steps: RULE: a ROOT session (any tier) may use hands-on WillKim tools (wkappbot cdp, file, suggest, eye, mail, a11y, win-click, taskkill) ONLY inside a delegation window. The window OPENS when a delegation (Agent.cmd, wkcodex, codex) completed within the last 5 minutes and CLOSES at the stall-guard threshold. Keep delegating to keep the privilege. Full build spec: memory/sonnet-wk-tool-delegation-gate-spec.md in personal-docs.

THE BALANCE: in exchange a root session gets an UNLIMITED conductor toolkit, always pace-exempt: all skill read search edit contribute, all markdown edits (CLAUDE.md, memory, AGENTS, any .md doc), the delegation launchers, and git. Root reads and records knowledge and delegates freely; it executes only through delegation. Build note: broaden the Edit Write pace-exemption from CLAUDE.md-only to all .md.

ROOT vs SUBAGENT axis: the gate keys on ROLE not tier. Opus-root is effectively a no-op (it delegates anyway). Sonnet-root is the real enforcement target (will not delegate without the rule). Haiku-root (token-starved fallback) is also gated. ANY subagent of any tier is EXEMPT because hands-on wk-tool work is its assigned job; subagents get only a soft cheaper-tier-first nudge.

WHY: Sonnet weekly percent spikes come from solo floundering plus repeated guard blocks, each forcing a full-context cache_read resend. Gating hands-on execution to a delegation window kills that churn and enforces the conductor pattern. Unifies with the Opus busy-fleet rule and the recursive-dialectic evidence gate and can later collapse into the evidence gate.

BUILD: guards.ps1 edit (the live harness is wkappbot-kih tools wkharness-guards.ps1). Stage soft-warn first then hard block. Reuse Get-WkRecentModelCount session-JSONL reverse-scan plus the existing stall-guard as the window ceiling. Selftest pairs: root plus restricted-wk plus no-recent-delegation fires; plus recent-delegation allows; skill read and Agent.cmd and git always allow; subagent or Opus session exempt.
